title: Kids Summer Camp
location: Aarohana Yoga Studio, 135B, 2nd Floor, Opp HDFC Bank, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, BEML Layout, RR Nagar, Bengaluru
tagline: Holistic learning for kids aged 6 to 14
description: Aarohana Yoga presents a joyful and enriching Kids Summer Camp! Running from May 4 to May 22, 2026, this camp offers children aged 6 to 14 a holistic experience blending Mantra Chanting, Mindfulness Practice, Yoga, Breath Work, Story Telling, and Fun Activities. A nurturing space where kids grow in body, mind, and spirit. Enroll by May 4.

title: Meditation for Healing — Online Course
tagline: Cultivate a Pure & Clear Mind with guided meditation
description: Experience the power of meditation in this 21-day online course by Aarohana Yoga. Beginner-friendly with no prior experience needed, you will learn to quiet the mind, build self-awareness, cultivate self-love, and experience inner transformation. Through expert-led guided sessions, you will develop tools and practices for holistic healing — mind, body, and spirit — that stay with you for a lifetime.

title: Workshop on Inner Child Healing
location: Aarohana Yoga Studio, 135B, 2nd Floor, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, BEML Layout, RR Nagar, Bengaluru
tagline: When we silence our inner child, we silence our joy.
description: A deeply transformative workshop designed to help you reconnect with your inner child — the part of you that holds unresolved emotions, old wounds, and forgotten joy. Through guided meditation, breathwork, and energy healing led by Dr. Meenakshi K S, this session created a safe space to acknowledge, nurture, and heal those deeper layers of yourself.
